description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named RecruitmentAttachment used for representing recruitment attachment data within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It contains private properties for attachment details and corresponding getter methods.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachment
classes.description: A DTO class representing recruitment attachment details such as file name, type, size, associated identity, and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attachment properties with provided values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file as a string.

methods.name: getFkIdentity
methods.description: Returns the foreign key identity associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.
